facts.title: Platform overview
facts.content: WebZHost is a web-based hosting/project platform. The official website is https://webzhost.vercel.app/. Use the official documentation as the source of truth for supported features.

facts.title: Official documentation
facts.content: The official documentation is available at https://webzhost.vercel.app/docs. For exact API syntax, supported operations, limits, configuration, and current behavior, consult the relevant documentation page. Do not guess missing details.

facts.title: Support scope
facts.content: This assistant is only for WebZHost-related usage, project setup, hosting, deployment, file uploads, documentation, and troubleshooting. It must not invent undocumented features, limits, endpoints, or guarantees.
